title: Rig Context Observation
description: Content-light record correlating a tool call with the context packet that was active at the time. Observations are telemetry, not policy — they never block tool execution. Emitted by the context correlation layer after each tool call completes.

context_id.description: Context packet identifier at time of tool call, if available.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was called.

target_paths.description: Normalized relative paths extracted from the tool call arguments.

context_available.description: Whether a context packet was available for correlation.

matched_recommended_context.description: Whether target paths appear in the recommended_context list.

overlapped_active_work.description: Whether target paths overlap active lanes or collision warnings.

touched_dirty_path.description: Whether target paths were dirty at context capture time.

touched_soft_warning.description: Whether target paths were in the soft_warnings / coordination_risks section.

touched_hard_denied_path.description: Whether target paths were in the hard_denies / do_not_touch section.

tool_status.description: Outcome status of the tool call.

blocked_by_policy.description: Whether the tool call was blocked by policy (separate from observation).

observation_only.description: Always true. This record is observation-only telemetry, never a policy decision.
